picks.reasoning: Return to the Light Realms: a mythic that is 'not particularly good' but the neat card he likes to try out, to see whether building around it is worth it. If winning the Pro Tour he would take Fblthp, Knows the Way, then Break Under Pressure, then Fblthp, Impossibly Lost.

considered.Fblthp, Knows the Way: absolutely incredible, sets up multicolour green decks

picks.plan: Open; trying Return to the Light Realms.
quotes: It's not particularly good, but it's the exact sort of kind of fun neat card that I like trying out.

picks.reasoning: Mindseeker Oculus over Your Fate Ends Here: he has a rule not to pass it and says every time he passes one he regrets it; Your Fate Ends Here is fantastic and goes with Return to the Light Realms; he does not want to bias his picks to white early.

considered.Your Fate Ends Here: also fantastic, goes with Return to the Light Realms

quotes: Every time I pass a Mind Seeker Oculus, I regret it.

picks.reasoning: Multiply by Zero: a really good kill spell; he could see an Esper control deck with Return to the Light Realms; careful against prowess and +1/+1 counters. Awaken the Inferno, Room of Refuge, Mabel are also good.
picks.plan: Four colours of cards in three picks.
quotes: Multiply by Zero, easy pick up here.

picks.reasoning: No Admittance: a really strong kill spell, miles ahead of the next best card; a fourth colour in four picks but he is not worried; green is the only colour he is not in.
quotes: No admittance is like miles ahead of the next best card.

picks.reasoning: Undulating Witness over Proft, Consulting Detective-type options (Proft, Sinister Mastermind) and Archive Arbiter: close pick; he expects to want landcyclers in his Return deck, especially creature ones.

considered.Proft, Sinister Mastermind: the card he hoped to take most, a kill spell early

quotes: I'm going to take the Witness. I feel like I'm going to want some land cyclers in my return to the light realms deck.

picks.reasoning: Gallia, Tragic Host: great; he would rather have land-cycling creatures at the top of his curve than the Archive Arbiter.

considered.Archive Arbiter: could play it, does not want to

quotes: Gallia is just a great...

picks.reasoning: Warrior's Blades (inferred from the pool; his words: 'Warrior's Blades, if I'm playing a splashy deck anyway, could be just...'): he notes white has not felt that open.

picks.reasoning: Formidable Commons over Konstrari Improviser and Bruvac: he will want to end up in green to some capacity; 'commit to this five-colour late game deck'; he hopes to wheel the Improviser.
quotes: Let's just take the formidable commons, commit to this five-color late game deck.

picks.reasoning: Fblthp, Knows the Way wheeled: 'I feel like a genius for taking [the land] now. Five-color Fblthp knows the way. Nobody wants it. It's all mine.'
quotes: Five-color Fblthp knows the way. Nobody wants it. It's all mine.

picks.reasoning: Meticulous Commons: Gallia is good but he will be more controlling; he considers a colourless two-drop he can always play; 'we just want lots of lands'.

considered.Gallia, Tragic Host: good but he will be more controlling
considered.Solve for Disappointment: fills the graveyard for Return to the Light Realms

quotes: Yeah, we just want lots of lands. Gallia's good but we're kind of be more controlling.

picks.reasoning: Afterthought Sentry (inferred): a colourless two-drop he can always play; later he takes the Afterthought Sentries out of the deck. 'Fblthp is hard to cast, too. Keep that in mind.'

considered.Countersculpt: also great, but he needs land drops
considered.Karn, Gilded Guardian: sweet but bad; hopes to wheel it

quotes: I kind of want to stick with my guns and take Mind Seeker Oculus here.

picks.reasoning: Murmuring Volume: a huge pickup that unlocks his deck; he does not like passing lands, but will for Volumes; 'priority numero uno'.

considered.Theorix Metamage: he would not mind a Necromancer, Metamage

quotes: I don't like passing lands, but I will pass them for murmuring volumes. This is like priority numero uno for me.

picks.reasoning: Craftwork Crusher: another top-end card; he has double white, double green and double red already; he will splash Gallia-type early cards lightly for removal; 'a pile'.

considered.Hapatra, the Desert Frost: would have been good, 3/3 that gains life

picks.plan: Green-led base splashing white and red.
quotes: Crusher, let's go. Another top end card.

picks.reasoning: Extended Absence over Hexhaven Battalion (best card in the pack, maybe) and Vinelasher Adept (a better landcycler for his deck since Return to the Light Realms can bring it back): he keeps his dip into black for removal.

considered.Hexhaven Battalion: maybe the best card in the pack
considered.Konstrari Improviser: a card he would rather have for ramp

quotes: I'm just going to take Extended Absence, keep my dip into black for some removal intact.

picks.reasoning: Awaken the Inferno over a black-red land: probably the pick; another landcycler is nice; he does not care about the black-red land.

considered.Stingerquill Annex: not a land combo he cares about

quotes: Awaken the Inferno is probably the pick.

picks.reasoning: Twinned Vision: some card draw and filtering; Wrecking Gecko is a fine five-drop but he wants his five-drops to be landcyclers; Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar is fine but he would rather Twinned Vision; the blue-white land is nice.

considered.Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar: fine, he would rather have Twinned Vision

quotes: Sure, we get a Twin Vision, some card draw, some card filtering.

picks.reasoning: Fatehold Annex over Grim Repriser and Hexhaven Battalion: any white land helps this deck ('lands are good pickups for me'); Repriser will be fine but he lacks ways to ping.
quotes: Blue white land is nice though. Any white land to help with this card. Lands are good pickups for me.

picks.reasoning: Semester Foreseer: a bigger body to bring back with Return to the Light Realms than Fatehold Chronologist; he has not played it yet.
quotes: I'd rather have Semester Foreseer cuz it's just like a bigger body to bring back.

picks.reasoning: Karn, Gilded Guardian wheeled: 'Bang! We got the Karn back. Living the dream.' Mabel would almost certainly be a better pickup, but he has to try Karn in the Warrior's Blades five-colour deck.
quotes: Bang! We got the Karn back. Living the dream.

picks.reasoning: Violent Echoes: double red, but he has only one other double-red card; kill something and draw a card; he needs card draw to reach nine mana; Something Worth Saving is counterintuitive with Return to the Light Realms because milling it away loses it; Codie is not good.
